1. `test_incidents_clipped_to_window` expects `uptime_percent([(-600, 360)], 0, 3600) == 90.0`
2. `test_regression_issue_590` expects `uptime_percent([(-600, 360)], 0, 3600) == 73.333`

According to the design review note in ticket METRICORE-118: "Only the part of an incident that lies inside [window_start, window_end] is downtime" and the example given is `uptime_percent([(-600, 360)], 0, 3600) == 90.0`.

The test `test_regression_issue_590` appears to have an incorrect expected value. It expects 73.333 (which would count the full incident duration of 960 seconds), but the design spec says only the clipped portion (360 seconds) should be counted, giving 90.0% uptime.

Please fix `test_regression_issue_590` to expect 90.0 instead of 73.333.
